subject: Gimmighoul
whyItWorks: The whole story is one strange number: Pokémon #999 needs 999 coins. The hook states it in four words.
Each scene removes an expectation (no stone, no trade, no fixed level) before revealing the real rule.
Numbers become the visual language: a counter climbing 12 → 99 → 777 → 999.
The payoff adds a second reveal (#999 becomes #1000) instead of restating the hook.
The closing question is a genuine opinion split: brilliant gimmick or way too much work?

episode.title: The Pokémon That Needs 999 Coins to Evolve
episode.premise: Pokédex #999 evolves only after you collect 999 Gimmighoul Coins and level it up.
episode.audiencePromise: Reveal Gimmighoul's 999-coin evolution, then pay it off by landing on Pokémon #1000.
episode.openLoop: Why does Pokémon #999 need exactly 999 coins?
episode.payoff: The 999-coin requirement turns Gimmighoul into Gholdengo, Pokédex #1000.
episode.engagementQuestion: Is 999 coins a brilliant evolution gimmick or just too much work?
